summary: This table presents a financial performance summary for a company, comparing key metrics across three time periods: December 31, 2024, December 31, 2023, and September 30, 2024. Key metrics include revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, operating profit, and net profit, along with their respective year-over-year (YoY) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) growth percentages. Notably, revenues increased by 5.9% YoY to $4,939 million in 2024, while net profit before minority interest rose by 10.4% YoY. The operating margin improved slightly to 21.3% in 2024. The table also highlights trends in operating expenses, with selling and marketing expenses showing a 6.9% increase YoY, while administrative expenses decreased by 2.2%. Overall, the data indicates a positive growth trajectory in key financial metrics.
